goal: Recognizable standing horse as one fused solid with jointed legs
geometry_plan: assume 1 px = 4 mm; map image (px, py) to x = (px - 450) * 4, z = (560 - py) * 4; camera on -Y so near legs sit at y = -150
barrel: loft through 7 ellipse sections on Plane.YZ.offset(x) with sizes following an ellipse profile
neck, tail, ears, leg segments: tapered Cone between two 3D points (segment helper using Plane(origin, z_dir))
leg joints: spheres slightly larger than the limb, rotated so their poles are not on the leg axis
head and muzzle: Sphere(1).scale(radii) ellipsoids; hooves: short cylinders
fuse everything into one solid; check solid_count == 1 with preview before the gate
unknowns: body width estimated at 0.78 of barrel height
